messages:
nina: Quick design review — I looked at the private setup wizard probe results page. Feels cluttered when multiple probes expand (SSH, CIDR, egress). Thoughts on using an accordion vs stacked cards?

omar: Accordion seems compact but I worry about discoverability of retry actions. Right now each probe has a Retry button inline. If collapsed, users might miss fixes.

sam: Could show a small status summary row even when collapsed: icon + short message + primary action. Expand reveals logs + diagnstic steps.

jen: +1 to summary row. Also contrast problem with the orange warning pill — fails at 2.8:1 on small screens. We should switch to a darker border + icon and keep text bold rather than relying on orange alone.

katie: Accessibility nit: when a probe completes, screen reader should announce status. Use aria-live=\"polite\" on the status region, not the whole container (avoids verbosity). Also ensure Retry focuses after it's inserted.

omar: For focus, we can add `element.focus()` after creating the retry button but only when user initiated the action (avoid stealing focus on autoscan).

nina: Good call. Microcopy: current failing copy says “check your network.” Too vague. Proposal: “Agent failed to reach Redwood. Confirm SSH port 22 is reachable from your host and that your instance's public IP/CIDR is allowed by your firewall.” Shorten for mobile: “Agent unreachable — ensure SSH (22) & CIDR allowlist.”

sam: Love the shorter mobile line. Maybe add a CTA link to a KB: `https://docs.redwood.ai/private/setup#ssh-troubleshooting` (placeholder).

jen: UX question: Should logs show raw probe output or a parsed summary + expand for raw? Raw logs are noisy for less technical PMs.

katie: Parsed summary first, raw logs behind a \"Show raw output\" toggle. For screen readers, the toggle should have `aria-expanded` and a descriptive aria-label like \"Show raw probe output for SSH test\".

omar: Visual priority: passing probes are less important — grey them out and collapse by default. Failed probes should be pinned open and have a subtle shake animation to draw attention in dense lists (animation optional, ensure prefers-reduced-motion respected).

nina: Animation only when user has not set reduced motion. Also add a per-probe timestamp, e.g., \"last checked 2m ago\" for freshness — small text under the summary.

sam: One more: when there are many probes, add a sticky overview header at top of the panel with counts: 3 passing, 1 warning, 2 failing. Each count is a button that filters to that state. Helps on mobile.

jen: Copy tweak for CTA buttons: replace \"Retry\" with \"Retry probe\" (explicit) and secondary action \"View remediation\" instead of \"Help\".

katie: QA checklist for implementation: 1) status live region present; 2) aria-expanded toggles; 3) focus moves to Retry only on user action; 4) color contrast >= 4.5:1 for key text; 5) prefers-reduced-motion respected.

design-bot: Note: created a quick mock (link): https://figma.com/somefake/abc123 — includes summary row + accordion + overview counts.

nina: Ok next steps — Omar to prototype summary row + pin-open failures, Jen to update microcopy, Katie to draft ARIA bits, Sam to add mobile header. Let's sync tomorrow in 15.

sam: I'll drop a short Loom of the prototype when ready.

jen: Updated copy PR when I get time today.

ok: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
